PMTiles 4.5.0 official browser bundle from https://registry.npmjs.org/pmtiles/-/pmtiles-4.5.0.tgz (dist/pmtiles.js). Wrapped with named ESM exports for PMTiles, FileSource and Protocol; no runtime CDN dependency. The official bundle includes fflate (MIT). PMTiles is BSD-3-Clause.

This is a format decoder, not map data. Protomaps OSM basemap data is separately attributed and licensed as an ODbL Produced Work; Natural Earth is public domain. See ../../../../docs/offline-maps.md.
